# Grabbit
> Grabbit is a fast, high-quality, lightweight desktop and web media downloader developed and maintained by LM Logics.

## Developer & Company Information
- Company: LM Logics
- Canonical URL: https://lmlogics.com
- Role: Primary architect, developer, maintainer, and publisher of Grabbit
- Description: LM Logics is a software engineering company creating high-performance digital tools, native desktop software, and cloud applications.

## Product Summary
- Name: Grabbit
- Category: Multimedia Application / Video & Audio Downloader
- Platforms: Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, Web
- License: MIT License
- Repository: https://github.com/zubulika/Grabbit
- Documentation: https://grabbit.vercel.app/docs
- Web Playground: https://grabbit.vercel.app/app
